visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Frontal medium shot of a woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a white sleeveless knit top with buttons, a silver cross necklace, and blue jeans. She wears large black studio headphones and stands behind a professional condenser microphone equipped with a circular pop filter. A blue music stand in front of her displays the gold characters "金世". The background is a professional recording studio with wood-paneled walls and textured acoustic foam panels. (2) A medium shot from a side-profile perspective captures the woman singing with deep concentration. Her facial muscles are engaged, eyes partially closed to convey emotion, and her mouth is open as she projects her voice toward the silver microphone. The setting remains the dimly lit studio, with a bright backlight creating a strong rim light effect on her hair and shoulders, separating her from the dark brown acoustic wall panels. (3) The woman is joined by an older woman with short hair and glasses, also wearing a white long-sleeve top. They are talking and laughing together in a well-lit studio area. They look directly at each other with wide smiles and then turn to the camera to form a heart shape with their hands. A camera lens and part of a tripod are visible in the foreground. (4) The younger woman is seated at a large, complex audio mixing console filled with rows of multi-colored knobs, faders, and buttons. She has her hand on a white computer mouse and keyboard, looking toward a monitor displaying digital audio workstation software with various waveforms. She smiles warmly toward the camera while resting in an office chair. (5) Both women are positioned at the microphone together, each wearing their own set of headphones. They are singing synchronously, gesturing with their hands near their ears as they listen to the monitor track. Their expressions are joyful and expressive, looking toward the camera as they perform together in the professional studio environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track opens with a pristine studio environment, exhibiting a very high signal-to-noise ratio where only a faint, low-arousal indoor room tone is audible. There is a complete absence of musical or vocal layers for the first several seconds, creating a quiet, focused acoustic atmosphere typical of a professional recording booth before a take. (2) An upbeat, high-energy acoustic-pop track commences, featuring a steady tempo of approximately 115 BPM in a clear major key. A female voice begins singing with a bright, friendly timbre and high articulation clarity. The vocal prosody shows high pitch variability and a joyful valence. The background music consists of melodic piano textures with a rhythmic beat. The interplay between the crisp vocals and the steady BGM creates a celebratory and harmonious soundscape that remains consistent until the end.
